bead.title: bench-pr-A3d: deactivate Go-runner cmd/bench execution subcommands (redirect to ./benchmark)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: cmd/bench/main.go still dispatches matrix|sweep|run|plan to the Go runner. Coexistence with the bash runner invites drift in profile resolution, pricing math, and report shape.

ROOT CAUSE:
  - cmd/bench/main.go: subcommand dispatch routes matrix/sweep/run/plan into Python-coupled Go code that was the reason for the rewrite.

PROPOSED FIX:
  1. Replace matrix|sweep|run|plan subcommand bodies with a stderr message instructing use of ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark; exit 2.
  2. Preserve read-only listing subcommands (profiles, bench-sets) functional until PR F.
  3. No changes to flag-parsing for the listing subcommands.

NON-SCOPE (preserved from parent):
  - cell-report.schema.json (PR B); bench-set schema (PR C)
  - Node collector/importers (PR D/E); deleting cmd/bench entirely (PR F); docs (PR G)
  - Harbor image, shell adapters, agent-leak fix (A1)
  - Bash runner core, --plan, report.json composition (A2)
  - Parity fixtures + diff.sh (A4)
  - flock / --jobs / in-flight.json (A3a)
  - Signal handling and docker cleanup (A3b)
  - Cost cap / budget.json (A3c)

GOVERNING: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification. Independent of A2/A3a/A3b/A3c.

ACCEPTANCE:
  1. TestBenchMainRedirectsExecutionSubcommands (cmd/bench/main_test.go) — exec `go run ./cmd/bench matrix`; expect exit code 2 and stderr containing `use ./benchmark`. Repeat for sweep, run, plan. `go test ./cmd/bench/... -run TestBenchMainRedirectsExecutionSubcommands`.
  2. TestBenchMainListingSubcommandsStillWork (cmd/bench/main_test.go) — `go run ./cmd/bench profiles` and `go run ./cmd/bench bench-sets` exit 0 and produce non-empty stdout.
  3. Shell variant: `fiz-bench matrix 2>&1 | grep -q 'use ./benchmark'` returns 0.

GATES: `go test ./...` green; `lefthook run pre-commit` green.
bead.acceptance: All 3 ACs pass; satisfies parent AC1, AC6, AC8; go test + lefthook gates green.
